research_question: accuracy and efficiency of unified multiple-criterion decision under already-aligned time and visible required evidence
scope_excludes: solving visually unclear or unavailable required evidence
existing_A_B_status: boundary/exclusion records for unresolved physical-side changes; preserve all prior drafts
primary_target: previously declared Portal1-source near-camera framing; uncalibrated
other_portal_admission: must be separately named and have independently observable physical sides; never silently replace primary portal
source_scope: already downloaded original ChokePoint P1E_S1 archive, existing C1 source, no new media download or inference
temporal_order_requirements: no missing original indices inside a proposed event span
no cross-camera alignment task or invented seconds
observable_event_requirements: fixed identifiable physical doorway and visible side reference
body or required ground-contact evidence sufficiently visible before and after
physical inside/outside transition supported rather than projected bbox overlap or visibility disappearance
association resolvable without face matching or unresolved multi-person ambiguity in the decisive interval
independent human review still required before final event GT
admission_states: visible candidate pending independent human labels
main_experiment_inclusion_requires: observable qualified candidate plus independent labels; no AI unknown relabelled as positive
bounded_screen: six new representative original C1 runs across full source axis; five indices per run; no full-run dense extraction or broad inference
first_run_rear_door_check: may inspect already restored originals as separately named control, without redefining A/B near-target labels
exhaustiveness_claim: bounded original-source screening only, not exhaustive event GT annotation of 2292 frames
no_sample_found_action: stop main-sample admission and report concrete missing evidence plus primary-source alternative leads; do not expand a framework around unknown
